scope: Finite readonly sfnt selected-directory order, search parameters, tag spaces, padding and representative table overlap observations

profile.input_snapshot_and_offsets: Original bytes and absolute source offsets
profile.overlap_strategy: Sweep by offset with farthest-reaching active range; one representative partner per overlapping nonempty table
profile.padding: Immediate bytes to next four-byte boundary, missing or nonzero recorded
profile.opaque_trailing_data: Retained, not reclassified as invalid padding
profile.search_fields: Derived from count; do not trust declared binary search parameters
profile.Anatomy_findings_budget: Remaining max_items after original source and selected tables

preservation: No font repair, byte rewriting or checksum changes
Existing hard bounds and invalid-table rejection remain enabled
Cancellation or finding quota failure returns no partial report
CLI compares the same audit on each input
limitations: Not a complete pairwise overlap graph or collection-wide shared-table audit
Glyph programs, shaping, rendering, signatures and legal embedding permission are outside this report
WOFF/WOFF2 and unsupported wrappers remain outside the sfnt profile
No Model changes or new dependencies; optional fontTools retained for other metadata profiles and actual subsetting
